say:1:1322516001:1.text: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.
say:1:1322516001:1.source_cn: 多亏了您的出手相助，既抓到了盗匪，又找回了赃物，挽回了...
say:1:1322516001:1.male: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.
say:1:1322516001:1.female: Thanks to your help, we managed to catch the thieves and return the stolen goods. The court's reputation is saved.

say:2:1322516002:1.text: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
say:2:1322516002:1.source_cn: 那些人已经全数下狱，正在等待审查。感谢您的帮助！
say:2:1322516002:1.male: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
say:2:1322516002:1.female: Those thieves are all locked up now, waiting for their trial. You've done us a great service!
